title: Origins Glue
description: Support for Origins on servers behind Velocity
body:
# Origins Glue
Adds support for the Origins mod to servers behind Velocity. Based on [origins-velocity-adapter](https://github.com/astei/origins-velocity-adapter). Doesn't do anything if Origins is not installed on the target server. Licensed under MIT like the original plugin.

## Usage
Install it like a normal Velocity plugin. **Velocity 3.4.0 or higher is required.**
